svg.title: Resultant field of two positive point charges
svg.desc: Computed field lines of two positive charges q1 and q2. At a point P above q1, the fields E1 from q1 and E2 from q2 add to a total field E that is tangent to the field line through P. At a point P′ below and between the charges, E′1 and E′2 add to E′, again tangent to the line there.
